market_definition: The phenolic adhesives market comprises thermosetting adhesives made from phenol- or resorcinol-formaldehyde resins that cure under heat to give durable, moisture- and heat-resistant bonds. It measures sales of finished adhesives and binders for bonding applications. BY RESIN TYPE: Phenol-Formaldehyde, Resorcinol-Formaldehyde, Phenol-Resorcinol-Formaldehyde, Other Phenolic Resins. BY FORM: Liquid, Powder, Film. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Plywood & Engineered Wood, Automotive Friction & Brake Bonding, Abrasives, Aerospace & Defense, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Urea- and melamine-formaldehyde adhesives; phenolic moulding compounds, foams and laminates; epoxy adhesives. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
